description: Source code for the SGP40 sensor driver in Zephyr RTOS, implementing measurement, configuration, self-test, and power management functions.

methods.name: sgp40_compute_crc
methods.description: Computes CRC for a 16-bit value using specified polynomial and initial value.

methods.name: sgp40_write_command
methods.description: Sends a command over I2C to the SGP40 device.

methods.name: sgp40_start_measurement
methods.description: Initiates a measurement on the SGP40 sensor.

methods.name: sgp40_attr_set
methods.description: Sets sensor attributes such as temperature and humidity.

methods.name: sgp40_selftest
methods.description: Performs a self-test on the SGP40 sensor.

methods.name: sgp40_sample_fetch
methods.description: Fetches a sample measurement from the sensor.

methods.name: sgp40_channel_get
methods.description: Retrieves the latest sensor data for a specific channel.

methods.name: sgp40_pm_action
methods.description: Handles power management actions for the sensor.

methods.name: sgp40_init
methods.description: Initializes the sensor device, performs self-test if enabled, and sets default attributes.
